hook: She Probably Never Said “Let Them Eat Cake”
text: Ask almost anyone what Marie Antoinette said, and they will tell you: let them eat cake. It is the most famous line in her story. And there is no good evidence that she ever said it. A very similar story, about a great princess and some hungry peasants, appears in the memoirs of Jean-Jacques Rousseau. He wrote it in the seventeen-sixties, while she was still a girl in Austria. The story was older than she was. It was simply attached to her name.
